proposals.title: Remove the daily image cap: Cloudflare Workers Paid (~$5/month) or top up OpenRouter
proposals.why: 34% of images this week came from the low-resolution fallback; providers were out of quota on 1 day(s). Paid images look sharper and let all 5 daily videos use real FLUX art.

proposals.title: Create the YouTube/TikTok/Instagram accounts and turn on auto-posting (Upload-Post)
proposals.why: Publish mode is local: videos are made but nobody sees them. Nothing else compounds until posts go out.

proposals.title: Start recording post metrics (views, retention, follows) so pillar weights and this scanner can use real data
proposals.why: Only 0 metric rows exist; the router stays balanced and profit ranking is impossible until ~10+.
